children: C&F Financial’s third-quarter net income rose year over year as community banking earnings and net interest income increased, supported by higher average loan and securities balances and a wider net interest margin. Lower mortgage banking income partly offset the gains.
² Reported as “Net income attributable to C&F Financial Corporation”. ³ Reported as “Net income per share - basic and diluted”.
: Annualized margin was 4.53%, up from 4.24% in the third quarter of 2025.
: Segment net income increased to $8.9M from $7.4M, driven primarily by higher interest income on loans and securities.
: Segment net income was $266,000 versus $641,000; lower gains on loan sales were partly offset by higher mortgage lender services income.
: Total originations increased 3.4% to $172.8M; rising rates contributed to a 22.7% decline in refinancings.
